stat_mechanics.damage_formula: Spell base damage x ATK x ATK Amplify x All Magic Damage x Critical (4 separate multiplicative groups: raise ALL four evenly rather than stacking one)

groups.atk: Base damage stat (default 100). All % ATK sources (Intelligence passive, Ruby...) are ADDITIVE with each other, then multiply spell damage. Titan's Power multiplies all bonus ATK by 1.5.
groups.atk_amplify: Independent multiplier applied on total ATK. High ATK + high Amplify = burst. Dragon's Heart multiplies Amplify by 1.3.
groups.all_magic_damage: Separate multiplier, but ADDITIVE with per-spell damage bonuses (class level / artifacts) so it is slightly weaker than ATK Amplify late game.
groups.critical: Crit Rate (% chance) and Crit Multiplier (200% = double damage).

cast_stats.magic_cooldown: CDR stacks multiplicatively (diminishing returns). Still the #1 priority stat in almost every build.
cast_stats.magic_size: Radius/width/blast area (Tsunami, Cyclone, Satellite...). Bigger = better crowd clear and damage stacking.
cast_stats.magic_duration: Lifetime of field spells (Blizzard, Frost Nova, Electric Zone, Cloaking). With enough Duration new casts land before old ones vanish.
cast_stats.number_of_magic: Projectile/object count (Magic Bolt, Spirit, Satellite). Mostly from per-spell level and special artifacts.

survival_stats.hp_recovery: HP regen per second AND the HP gained from Life Orbs.
survival_stats.damage_reduction: Reduces damage taken; sources multiply (diminishing returns).
survival_stats.evasion: % chance to fully dodge a hit.
survival_stats.movement_speed: Escape encirclement late game and slip through gaps.
survival_stats.item_pickup_range: Magnet radius for Mana Orbs, hearts and Runes.

magic_combination_rules.chances: Combination option appears on character Level 25, 50 and 75 (3 chances; Gate of Creation gives +2 more).
magic_combination_rules.mechanics: Two MAX-LEVEL spells merge. The Primary is enhanced, the Secondary is LOST and cannot be used or combined again. The specific Level-7 attribute (trait) of each spell decides which fusion is possible.
magic_combination_rules.final_fusion: Deus Ex Machina = Overmind + all passive spells; only available as the 3rd combination; afterwards no more combinations, Max Level +10.
